title: TAI general-agro answer completeness and activation acceptance repair
objective: Require useful concrete factors in broad agriculture and agribusiness answers while preserving model-first, fail-open content routing and fail-closed authority boundaries.
boundaries: Do not weaken, remove, skip or make optional any RU, EN, ZH, SSE, Chromium, mobile, subject-relevance or substantive-factor acceptance assertion
General-agro answers remain model-first and must name at least two applicable observable or measurable decision factors before clarification
The completeness frame is reusable across crop production, irrigation, livestock, machinery, storage, farm infrastructure, economics and farm IT rather than a single hard-coded answer
Do not fabricate agronomic doses, pesticide rates, veterinary medicines, machinery specifications, diagnostic codes, compatibility, prices, laws, integrations or production status
Private model transport, HMAC authority, role and tenant boundaries, secret redaction, no-write guarantees and current-evidence controls remain unchanged
Activation failure evidence retains the actual failed public answer and completed-case metadata
The activation workflow runs when the restricted public Qwen service or its tests change
Dependency and lockfile authority comes exclusively from current main; this branch carries no dependency remediation or exception
No paid model, SaaS, hosting, database or recurring cost is added

Completion requires exact-head checks, exact-main merge, canonical images, REG.RU release, preflight, protected Qwen activation, 21 endpoint and 5 mobile Chromium cases, finalization accept and postflight
